name: JW Marriott Phu Quoc Emerald Bay Resort & Spa

address.street: Bai Khem Phu Quoc District An Thoi Town

insider_take: This architectural marvel rises like a fantastical university campus from Phu Quoc's pristine coastline, where French colonial academia meets tropical luxury in the most unexpected way.
whats_special: Designed by renowned architect Bill Bensley, this resort reimagines a fictional French university called "Lamarck University" - complete with academic buildings, libraries, and dormitories transformed into luxury accommodations. Each villa tells a unique story of imaginary professors and students, while the property sits on Khem Beach, consistently ranked among Vietnam's most beautiful stretches of sand.
pro_tip: Book the "Headmaster's House" - the resort's most exclusive villa that comes with its own private beach section and dedicated butler service, plus access to the secret rooftop bar with panoramic island views.
dont_miss: The Pink Pearl - the resort's signature overwater bar built to resemble a giant pearl shell, and the night market recreation within the resort featuring local Phu Quoc specialties. Time your visit for sunset at the "Dean's Office" infinity pool, where the Gulf of Thailand creates a natural backdrop for the island's famous pepper plantations visible in the distance.
pros: Stunning beachfront location on Emerald Bay with pristine white sand beach
Unique French colonial architecture and design throughout the property
World-class spa facilities and wellness amenities
Multiple dining venues featuring international and Vietnamese cuisine
cons: Remote location requires transfers to reach main island attractions
